result_distribution_note: The measured outputs of the reported experiments (checkpoints, predictions, propensity-logged trajectories, statistical outputs, executed split/seed memberships and observed environments) are assets of the GitHub release paper-artifacts of this repository, listed with SHA-256 identities in release/paper_artifacts.json. `make paper` downloads and verifies them, rebuilds every numbered table and figure with paper/build/displays and compares every computed value with the printed one. Entries awaiting publication are marked as such; nothing is substituted for them.

manuscript_registry.role: Numerical comparison targets and protocol constants transcribed with page provenance; run-derived tables and figures read archived observations.

data_use_sequence: official train 60/20/10/5/5 fit/explore/select/confirm/compare; compare reserved during prepare; official validation admit; official test after lock
site_profile_policy: run_cross_morse.sh carries the Arrhenius site settings (partition, GPU request, architecture, modules, PyTorch wheel, storage layout) in its SITE SETTINGS block; configs/arrhenius-site.env.example holds the NAISS allocation and storage project as placeholders for a private copy, and configs/public.env.example is the template for another cluster

measurement_records_contract.tool: scripts/records.py (make records-index, make records-check, make records-tables)
measurement_records_contract.trace: every summary value is re-read from its raw log at its printed precision

manuscript_documents: PDFs are not distributed. paper/sources.json retains reference hashes, sizes, page counts and table/page mappings; optional local copies can be byte-verified.

reconstruction_workspace.scope: Verified input bytes and generated outputs with per-display coverage; supporting checks are not full numerical displays. Original experiment identity is checked separately.
